annotations.title: Crypto address validator (EVM EIP-55, Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, XRP, Stellar, Cosmos, Cardano)

description: Crypto address validator (EVM EIP-55, Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, XRP, Stellar, Cosmos, Cardano) — Validate and identify blockchain addresses offline before sending funds. address= one address or addresses= up to 25 (comma/space separated); optional chain= (e.g. base, ethereum, bitcoin, solana, tron) flags a valid address on the wrong chain (verdict WRONG_CHAIN). Checks: EVM 0x addresses with full EIP-55 checksum verification (Keccak-256) and the normalized checksummed form, zero/burn address warnings; Bitcoin/Litecoin/Dogecoin/Dash/Zcash/Tron base58check (double SHA-256) with P2PKH/P2SH and network; bech32/bech32m segwit per BIP173/BIP350 (P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR taproot, witness-version/encoding rules, mixed case rejected); Cosmos-SDK bech32 prefixes (cosmos, osmo, celestia, inj, sei, dydx...); Cardano addr/stake (address type); Solana base58 32-byte keys (no checksum - warned); XRP classic (ripple alphabet); Stellar G... (CRC16). Verdict VALID/INVALID/WRONG_CHAIN (batch: ALL_VALID/SOME_INVALID/ALL_INVALID). Format check only - does not prove ownership or funds; use /v1/crypto/address for on-chain state. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: crypto_address_validate
